new_results.statement: For a one-hub original-coordinate form with rank-r exact leaf curvature, positive combined Gram G and normalized leaf row leverages <=1/2, arbitrary diagonal leaf curvature, affine terms and outside couplings, the density is C0 and bounded by ((r+2)/r)e^((r+1)/(r+2))|kappa|^(-2/(r+2))|det C|^(-1/(r+2))det(G)^(-1/(r+2)).
For orthonormal b,d and |kappa|,|lambda|>=1, Q=2kappa X0<b,X>+lambda<d,X>^2 has ||p_Q||_infinity<=256 for arbitrary independent density-cap-one inputs; both (+,+,-) and (+,-,-) are covered.

The harmonic b,d family has exact spectrum {-1,1,1}, all physical pair scales ->0 and every disjoint cross cut rank<=2, so partner pair/ridge certificates are not exhaustive although the new hub-Fresnel theorem gives a uniform bound.
For b=e1,d=e2 and centered unit uniforms, the absolute joint Fourier majorant is a product of two divergent absolute sinc integrals, so the leverage gate cannot simply be deleted from that proof.

first_unpaid_implication: QFORM-HUB-FRESNEL-ROBUST-SELFCOUPLING-v1: extend the paid hub/Fresnel product mechanism to arbitrary dense leaf self-coupling in the source-valid scale regime without moment/support assumptions or perturbative deletion; alternatively force a completed pair/ridge/volume-sampling certificate or produce a genuine target counterexample.
